name: Pokémon anime (main series and films 1–19)
description: The Pokémon TV anime (Ash Ketchum series 1997–2023, then Horizons) and the main-series anime films 1–19. No calendar years; ordered by Japanese broadcast/release. Wikipedia: "The anime franchise consists of eight sequential series in Japan, each based on a main installment of the Pokémon video game series. In the international broadcasts, these series are split across 29 seasons. … Starting with the 26th season, a new cast is featured, centering on protagonists Liko and Roy. … The films star Pokémon Trainer Ash Ketchum and his partner Pokémon, Pikachu."

name: Pokémon films: alternate timeline trilogy
description: Films 20, 21 and 23 (I Choose You!, The Power of Us, Secrets of the Jungle), which form an alternate timeline separate from the TV anime. Wikipedia: "It is the twentieth film of the Pokémon anime series and the first film of the alternate timeline trilogy. … Set in an alternate timeline, the film follows the journey of Pokémon Trainer Ash Ketchum"

name: Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution (CGI remake)
description: 2019 CGI remake of the first film; kept separate so the same story is not ordered twice in the anime continuity. Wikipedia: "It is the twenty-second film of the Pokémon anime series and a CGI remake of Pokémon: The First Movie (1998)."

name: Detective Pikachu (live-action)
description: Live-action film based on the Detective Pikachu spin-off game; separate from the anime. Wikipedia: "Detective Pikachu is based on the 2016 video game Detective Pikachu and stars Ryan Reynolds as the motion capture role of Detective Pikachu"

name: Pokémon core-series games
description: One title per core-series generation; ordered by release. Wikipedia: "The anime franchise consists of eight sequential series in Japan, each based on a main installment of the Pokémon video game series. [games are the source the anime adapts, not the same continuity]"
